items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: And Ben Webster was on that session too.

ctx.x: Yeah, he wanted to ask me something, and he said, Previn called and told me to ask you, could he be on your next session and I said, 'are you kidding?' I'd love to have him on all the sessions.
Oh, that was good. Well listen, in 1960 you made a session with strings, do you remember?
